goal: Merge overlapping intervals given as a list of [start, end] pairs
assumptions: Input is a list of intervals, each interval is a list of exactly two integers [start, end].
Intervals are closed: both start and end are inclusive.
Two intervals overlap if one starts before or at the other's end and ends after or at the other's start (i.e., start <= other_end and end >= other_start).
If intervals merely touch (end of one equals start of another), they are merged into one.
The input list may be empty; in that case an empty list is returned.
The input list may contain a single interval; it is returned as a list containing that interval.
Intervals may have negative start/end values.
Intervals may be unsorted in the input.
Duplicate intervals are merged into one.
The output intervals are sorted in ascending order by start time.
The function does not modify the input list.
Invalid input (non-list, non-integer elements, intervals not of length 2) is not handled; behavior is undefined.
